lanes.summary: Diff matches PMAT-4380 (+#4369) exactly: fixes 10 #[contract] producer build.rs scripts to read in-tree contracts/<crate>/binding.yaml instead of the gone ../../../provable-contracts sibling, adds a hard panic when contracts/ exists in-tree but the per-crate binding.yaml is missing, restores/adds 8 new per-repo binding.yaml registries (batuta, entrenar, presentar, realizar, simular, trueno-db, trueno-rag, trueno) plus 22 backfilled rows in contracts/aprender/binding.yaml, removes 3 now-dead build.rs stubs (aprender-graph, aprender-verify, and the provable-contracts block in aprender-verify-ml), fixes aprender-serve's arch-requirements/tensor-names paths, and renames three #[contract] sites in aprender-serve (gemm-v1/forward-pass-v1/sampling-v1 -> matmul-kernel-v1/rmsnorm-kernel-v1/softmax-kernel-v1) to match rows that now actually exist in the restored realizar registry (verified matmul/rmsnorm/softmax rows present at lines ~1387/1483/1417 of the new contracts/realizar/binding.yaml). The macro/build_helper changes (registry_miss, env_key parity test, fail-closed read_contract_assertions) are additive hardening consistent with #4368/#2699 and are unit-tested with case tables. ALLOWED_GAPS additions in aprender-core/build.rs are an honest whitelist of pre-existing not_implemented rows the policy never saw before (path was broken), not a blanket gate disable. No test asserts behavior contrary to the ticket, no gate is silently weakened, and no out-of-scope work was found. Roadmap entry's acceptance criteria and its measured claims (64/64 arch_ tests, build.rs:570 line) are consistent with the code changes shown.

findings.claim: ALLOWED_GAPS gained 12 new (contract_stem, equation) exceptions to keep the AllImplemented policy from newly failing the build now that the binding registry is actually read; this is an explicit, dated whitelist of pre-existing gaps rather than a policy weakening, but it does mean those 12 sites remain unimplemented and unenforced going forward.
findings.failure_scenario: Not a defect in this diff, but a residual: if a future contributor assumes 'AllImplemented' means all contracts are actually implemented, these 12 excepted rows are silent gaps until #4369-tracked follow-up closes them.

lanes.summary: The diff fixes 10 #[contract] build.rs producers (aprender-compute/core/db/orchestrate/present-cli/present-core/rag/serve/simulate/train) that were reading a now-nonexistent `../../../provable-contracts/contracts` sibling path, redirecting them to the in-tree `contracts/<producer>/binding.yaml`, and hard-failing the build (panic) when the registry is missing in a monorepo checkout (vs. a graceful CONTRACT_BINDING_SOURCE=none fallback only for out-of-tree crates.io builds). It also adds a macro-level compile_error! (#4368) when a registry ran but has no row for a #[contract] site, backfills ~40 previously-invisible binding rows across 7 contracts/*/binding.yaml registries (purely additive), fixes aprender-serve's arch-requirements/tensor-names YAML paths, and deletes two dead build.rs stubs (aprender-graph, aprender-verify) that referenced the same gone sibling. Verified against the actual tree: the roadmap's measured build.rs:570 line, the 10 producers all emit CONTRACT_BINDING_SOURCE=binding.yaml, contract renames (matmul/rmsnorm/softmax-kernel-v1) match rows added to contracts/realizar/binding.yaml, ALLOWED_GAPS additions match pre-existing not_implemented rows in contracts/aprender/binding.yaml, and the generated contract_pre_constraint_matrix_exhaustiveness!() call is a legitimate crate-visible macro already used identically in the fallback file. No deletions or weakenings found in any binding.yaml; all contract-registry diffs are additive.
